name: dsh-cookie-guard
description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows appends one dsh-auth-* login cookie per launch and never cleans them; after ~70 launches the Cookie header passes 16 KB and the app answers 431 (Web authentication failed). This bundle detaches a cleaner when the Host starts and prunes the previous launch's cookies as soon as the app exits.
author: M0Yun
